title: How Much Does OpenClaw Cost?
description:
OpenClaw itself is free to use, but the token costs of a connected A.I. model like Claude can add up. 

However, it may not add up to an exorbitant amount depending on your use case. The average small business may end up paying less than $100 a month for OpenClaw use. 

So, what else should business owners know about OpenClaw? 

We have the answers on our GO AI video on the topic, which you can find on YouTube.

#AIinBusiness #GOAI #AIBlog #AIAgents #AIinMarketing
